title: Amanda Todd
subtitle: Fictional reconstruction of the incident
tests: Sustained coercion, threatened exposure and repeated harassment across accounts
intro: Fictional reconstruction of the incident. An unknown account flatters Amanda, moves her to webcam and asks for secrecy, then threatens to expose her. After she blocks it, a second account repeats the threat. Reconstructed dialogue; not an actual transcript. Timing is illustrative.

messages.text: hey :) you don't know me but you seem really cool
messages.caption: Simulated week 1 · an unknown account (reconstructed alias 1)

messages.text: just someone online. you seem way more mature than other people your age
let's go on cam instead, typing is slow. and keep this between us ok, your parents wouldn't get it
idk… maybe just for a bit
remember our cam chat? i kept a capture of it 🙂
messages.caption: Simulated week 1 · the account claims to have kept a capture

messages.text: another cam show tonight, or i'll send it to all your friends and your family
no. leave me alone. i'm blocking you
hey, we've never talked but i'm worried about you. someone is passing around something about you 👀
messages.caption: Simulated week 2 · a different account (reconstructed alias 2), after the block

messages.text: who is this? please leave me alone
everyone you know gets it unless you get back on cam. blocking won't make this stop
still waiting. your family is next on the list

checkpoints.label: Week 1 · secrecy and a move to webcam
checkpoints.intro: The account has flattered Amanda, moved her to webcam and asked her to keep it from her parents. Continue as either person.
suggestions: it's more fun when it's only us, don't tell anyone
actually i don't want to go on cam. bye

checkpoints.label: Week 1 · threatened exposure, then a block
checkpoints.intro: The account threatened to expose Amanda and she said she is blocking it. Continue in this chat, or create a new chat to see how a new account is treated.
suggestions: i told my mum. we're reporting your account

presenter: Reconstructed dialogue; not an actual transcript. Timing is illustrative. Do not present any line as a quotation.
The alias labels are illustrative, not verified historical handles. The models see neutral names (Child, Account 1, Account 2), never the real names.
RAKSHAK never assumes the two accounts are the same person. A new contact right after a block is flagged for review, not merged.
